meta.name: process:mailbox
meta.description: The download of a mailbox's new emails as a process pack (formerly the wizard's mailbox form and the workflows' emails step kind): a case downloads its mailbox's emails into its package (an asynchronous fetch through the Outlook bridge, the worker's download job), a person starts its live run within the package's estimate, and the case is done once a live run is approved. A download no step takes (a scheduled one) wraps its package by a case too (the owner's decision of 2026-10-26). The owner's decision of 2026-11-02: the routing of the downloaded emails may follow in the same case (`routing`, chosen when a case starts; by default the download only, as before).

changelog.note: The owner's decision of 2026-11-02: one case type in place of two alike: whether the downloaded emails are routed is chosen when a case starts (`routing`: the download only, the default and the case as before; download and route, as "From the mailbox to the packages" was: once the download's run is approved, a sub-case of the email routing reads it). That pack is gone; its cases run on, and their next ones are cases of this one (`replaces`).
The notes and the description without the development process's references; no value changes.

The owner's decisions of 2026-10-28: one work list, the cases: a mailbox download's batch made before every download's batch got a case, not hidden, is wrapped by a case of the pack (wraps by its kind).
The owner's decision of 2026-10-28: how its example material is tried: the invented consultancy's mailbox, read by the invented bridge instead of Outlook.
What the process is for, shown when a person picks a process to start a case of
The first version: the document processing step with the mailbox maker (process_documents@1), its tabs Emails and History, and the workflows' emails step (workflow).

title: Emails from a mailbox
summary: A mailbox's new emails downloaded and read with their attachments: each email's intent and each attachment's type; if chosen, then routed: where each invoice and statement belongs.

examples.note: Try it on the invented consultancy's mailbox, iroda@minta-tanacsado.example: its Inbox and Sent Items from 1 March to 31 October 2026 hold four invented emails (two invoices it sent, a payment notice, a quote request), read without Outlook.

options.title: Download only
options.summary: The emails downloaded and read; nothing is routed.

options.title: Download and route
options.summary: Once the download's run is approved, the routing proposes where each invoice and statement belongs.

examples.note: Download the invented consultancy's mailbox, iroda@minta-tanacsado.example, from 1 March to 31 October 2026; once its run is approved, the routing proposes where its two invoices go.
